title: Your stolen phone: tap to see its location
scenario: Hours after your phone was stolen, you get an email on another device: 'tap here to see your phone's current location,' asking you to log in to confirm it's really you.

answers.A: Log in through the link to try to track the phone quickly.
answers.B: Go directly to the official Find My / device-manager app or website instead of the emailed link.
answers.C: Log in through the link, and also share the passcode when it asks.

explanation: After a theft, scammers send lookalike 'find your device' emails to phish the very account credentials that would let them unlock and resell the stolen phone.
proTip: Track a stolen device through the real app you already have, not a link that emailed you first.
